group: TECO / Chair of Pervasive Computing Systems, Health Tech Center at KIT
title: Wearable Computing in Health Technologies (hardware, systems, AI) (full time, E13 payment)
topic: Health sensors and wearables, tiny AI for very small embedded systems, AI-assisted data curation and diagnostics, evaluated with hospitals
why_fit: Advert asks for tiny AI on very small embedded systems, Edge-ML, hardware/software dev chains and real running projects, which matches his deployed Raspberry Pi wake-word + fall-detection system
overqualified_angle: Only a Master's in CS or related field is required. He brings int8 QAT, a deployed edge system and 3 papers, while the advert treats Edge-ML experience as a bonus
competition: medium (KIT name draws applicants, but a standing advert with an email application and a niche embedded-health profile thins the field)
english_requirement: No language or test requirement stated on page
evidence: We especially looking into tiny AI, so AI suitable for very small embedded systems
red_flags: Apply by email with CV, transcript and motivation letter, but the email address does not appear on the page (contact Prof. Beigl via the TECO site). Advert has no posting date, so it may be an old standing post. Confirm by email that it is still open. PhD-or-PostDoc combined advert.

group: TECO / Chair of Pervasive Computing Systems
